title: Scoliosis5K: Multimodal Gait Analysis via Clip-Conditioned RGB-Silhouette Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2611.26849v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Color walking video records body boundary motion alongside clothing folds, surface appearance, and recording-environment cues. To examine what an explicit binary silhouette contributes to participant-level classification of scoliosis-related gait when a classifier already observes the paired color sequence, we construct Scoliosis5K, a multi-site collection of 4,998 corridor-walking sequences across 3,010 participant identifiers in which RGB person crops, binary silhouettes, and two-dimensional poses share each recording identifier and frame index. Our architecture uses each patch's pixel deviation from its clip mean to weight two low-rank query and value updates inside a pretrained RGB encoder, fusing the resulting video representation with a silhouette transformer sequence and regional kernel ridge scores extracted from one native-resolution RGB frame per window. translated_title: Scoliosis5K：基于片段条件化的RGB-轮廓融合的多模态步态分析
translated_abstract: 彩色行走视频在记录人体边界运动的同时，也包含衣物褶皱、表面外观和录制环境等线索。为了考察当分类器已经观察到配对的彩色序列时，显式的二值轮廓对参与者级别的脊柱侧凸相关步态分类有何贡献，我们构建了Scoliosis5K数据集——一个多中心采集的数据集，包含3,010名参与者的4,998条走廊行走序列，其中RGB人体裁剪图、二值轮廓和二维姿态共享相同的录制标识符与帧索引。我们的架构利用每个图像块像素相对于其片段均值的偏差，在预训练的RGB编码器内对两个低秩的查询和值更新进行加权，并将所得的视频表示与轮廓Transformer序列以及从每个窗口中一帧原始分辨率RGB帧提取的区域核岭回归分数进行融合。在五个参与者不相交的交叉验证折中，对988名参与者进行了评估……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了多中心多模态步态数据集Scoliosis5K，并提出片段条件化的RGB-轮廓融合架构，用于脊柱侧凸相关步态的参与者级分类。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Scoliosis5K, a multi-site multimodal gait dataset, and proposes a clip-conditioned RGB-silhouette fusion architecture for participant-level classification of scoliosis-related gait.
